report.title: Send error report
report.heading: Send an error report
report.crash_heading: The program stopped with an error. Would you like to send an error report about it?
report.intro: The report goes to the developer and is not made public. Nothing is sent until you click Send.
report.item_error: The error message and the step that failed
report.item_versions: The program's version, the Windows version, the language and the theme
report.item_job: Your choices for the run and which steps were done (languages, cuts, voice)
report.item_log: The last lines of the log file (what the program has done)
report.never: The video, the audio and the subtitles are never included. Your user folder, your user name and the names of the videos are hidden.
report.sent: Thank you. The error has been sent (#{ref}).
report.sent_no_ref: Thank you. The error has been sent.
report.queued: It will be sent the next time there is a network connection.
report.queued_busy: The server is busy right now. It will be sent the next time you start the program.
report.button_hint: The report goes to the developer so the error can be fixed.
